title: The Secret Helper
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji gripped the Turtle Shell Fragment, the Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently—a blurry vision flashed through his mind: Chen Nian imprisoned on a blood-red altar, and a name he had never seen before that chilled his heart.

text.content: In the dark ruins, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The old man who had handed him the Tianji Record Fragment in these ruins now stood with hands clasped behind his back, as if stepping out of ancient primordial times, surrounded by faint golden light that was ancient and desolate, carrying an authority that even time could not erode.

dialogue.content: "No need for surprise, young friend." The aged voice rang like an ancient bell, carrying the composure of one who has seen through worldly affairs. "This old one has waited for this day for three thousand seven hundred years."

text.content: Three thousand seven hundred years. Chen Ji silently repeated this number in his heart, his expression unmoved. His gaze swept over the old man's entire form like a blade, trying to find flaws in that illusory figure. Yet beneath the golden light, he felt only an unfathomable antiquity and gravitas, as if facing an unscalable ten-thousand-zhang peak.

dialogue.content: "You are the First Palace Master of the Heavenly Secrets Palace." Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice so calm it held not a trace offluctuation. "But the Heavenly Secrets Palace was destroyed ten thousand years ago—you cannot possibly still be alive."

The old man smiled, that smile carrying inexhaustible vicissitudes: "What you say is correct, young friend. This body has long been reduced to dust in the annals of history. This old one is merely a remnant will, dwelling within the first page of the Tianji Record, guarding it until now."

text.content: The first page of the Tianji Record. Chen Ji's pupils barely perceptibly narrowed. He looked down at the fragment in his palm—the yellowed surface, beyond the original obscure runes, now faintly revealed a seated human silhouette. That phantom was exactly like the old man before him, gazing at him with what seemed like a knowing smile.

dialogue.content: "You may wonder why, since this old one has always been hidden here, I did not appear sooner to guide you?" The old man's voice carried a hint of self-mockery. "Because the timing was not yet right. Each page of the Tianji Record requires a catalyst to unlock, and today—you have finally reached this point."

choice.prompt: Facing this elderly man who claimed to be the residual soul of the Heavenly Secrets Palace's First Palace Master, Chen Ji had to make a judgment.

choices.description: This person came too suspiciously. How could the secrets of the Tianji Record be explained in just a few words? I'll test the waters first.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information to judge authenticity
choices.risk_hint: If the other party is genuine, I might lose the initiative

text.content: "Since you've waited three thousand seven hundred years," Chen Ji's lips slightly curved, his tone carrying a hint of playfulness, "I'm sure you won't mind waiting a moment more. The junior is foolish and still needs to confirm your identity first." He secretly mobilized the foresight power of the Tianji Record, attempting to glimpse some clue through the fog.

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record chose him, there must be reason. Since he's already come this far, why not hear what this ancient sage has to say.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock deeper secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The mission is arduous; he may be drawn into a larger maelstrom

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly put away his vigilance. He cupped his hands toward the old man in a formal bow: "Since the senior has words to say, Chen Ji listens respectfully." A flash of approval appeared in the old man's eyes. His illusory form slightly nodded, and the golden light around him intensified severalfold.

dialogue.content: "Do you know where the Tianji Record comes from?" The old man was not angered by Chen Ji's questioning. Instead, he posed a seemingly irrelevant question. "The world believes the Tianji Record is a prophetic secret code left behind by ancient immortals, but they do not know its true identity—it is a fragment of the nemesis of the Eye of Heavenly Providence."

text.content: The Eye of Heavenly Providence. Chen Ji's pupils abruptly contracted. He had seen this name many times in the scattered passages of the Tianji Record, but no one had ever truly explained its meaning to him. It was an existence that transcended everything, the concrete manifestation of Heavenly Will, the eternal dark cloud over every prophet.

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand years ago, the Eye of Heavenly Providence attempted to control the fates of all living beings in the world," the old man's voice gradually grew heavy. "This old one, together with several fellow cultivators, struck and shattered a trace of its primordial source. That fragment scattered across the world, becoming the parent text of the Tianji Record—its sole purpose is to end the chess game of the Eye of Heavenly Providence."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his mind thunder. All along, he had thought the Tianji Record was merely a tool for glimpsing heavenly secrets, never imagining that behind it lay such earth-shaking secrets. He looked down at the fragment in his palm and suddenly felt that the yellowed paper had become a thousand times heavier.

dialogue.content: "Fate Cards are the core of the Tianji Record." The old man continued. "You have already obtained two. The third is in your sister Chen Nian's possession—she was taken by the Holy Sect not by coincidence, but by the layout of the Eye of Heavenly Providence. When the three cards unite, they can rewrite core fate and break the Heavenly Shackles."

text.content: Chen Nian. The blurry foresight visions in the Tianji Record suddenly found their answer—not because the Tianji Record was incomplete, but because Chen Nian carried the third Fate Card. That card's aura disrupted all foresight. Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, his knuckles turning white from the force.

dialogue.content: The old man raised his hand, and a streak of golden light flew from his fingertips, transforming into a Turtle Shell Fragment the size of a palm before Chen Ji. The Turtle Shell was simple and mottled, covered with runes similar to those on the Tianji Record Fragment, emanating a faint glow in the darkness.

"This is the chess piece this old one personally planted in ancient times." The old man's form had begun to fade, the golden light gradually dimming. "Within the Turtle Shell is sealed the missing core chapter of the Tianji Record, also the final key. With it, you can activate the power of the third Fate Card."

text.content: Chen Ji reached out to take the Turtle Shell Fragment. The moment it touched his palm, there was a hint of warmth, as if it still retained the body temperature of that First Palace Master from ten thousand years ago. He watched the old man's gradually dissipating form and suddenly spoke: "Why did the senior choose me? Atrash servant, how could I bear such a great responsibility?"

dialogue.content: The old man's laughter echoed in the void, carrying an indescribable sense of relief: "trash? Hehe... The Tianji Record never choosestrash. It chooses those who can see through fate. Chen Ji, you walk the world in the guise oftrash, yet you've manipulated the three great Sects and the Holy Demon Sect in the palm of your hand—who in this world is more qualified to wield the Tianji Record than you?"

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. The old man was right—he had never been anytrash—he had simply hidden all his edge beneath that cowardly exterior. He raised his head toward the fading golden illusion and suddenly performed a deep bow: "Senior, rest assured. Since Chen Ji bears the weight of the Tianji Record, I will certainly shoulder the responsibility of breaking the game."

dialogue.content: "Good." The old man's voice was already like a candle in the wind,断续断续. "This old one... has little time left. The knowledge of the Tianji Record's first page has been fully transmitted to you. The path ahead... you must walk it yourself. Remember... the Eye of Heavenly Providence will never sit and wait for death. It has... placed someone... beside you..."

text.content: Before the words finished, the old man's form had completely turned into scattered golden light and dissipated in the void. Leaving only that Turtle Shell Fragment quietly resting in Chen Ji's palm, and an unfinished warning—had the Eye of Heavenly Providence placed someone beside him? Who was it? Ling Yuan? Han Lie? Or... Chen Ji dared not think further.

He tucked the Turtle Shell Fragment into his chest, feeling that warmth seep through his clothes into his skin. The runes on the Tianji Record Fragment were slowly changing. A line of unprecedented text appeared: "Heavenly Secrets Palace Secret Manual · Final Volume · Fate Sovereign." He had finally obtained the power to rewrite fate, and the cost was—opposition to the entire Heavenly Chess Game.

At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently, and a blurry vision forcibly invaded Chen Ji's mind—Chen Nian bound to an altar by blood-red chains, surrounded by the eerie incantations of demonic cultivators. And in the deepest part of the vision, a pair of scarlet eyes pierced through time and space, gazing directly at him, as if saying: "I've been waiting for you for a long time."

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, cold sweat already soaking his back. The gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Providence—he had finally felt it with absolute clarity. It was a pressure beyond words, a凝视 from Fate itself. Yet the corner of his mouth instead curved into a cold smile: since the identity had already been revealed, there was nothing left to hide. Chen Nian, he would definitely rescue her; the Heavenly Chess Game, he would definitely break it with his own hands.
